name: Plastics, Inc.
old_description: Plastics, Inc. is a manufacturer of precision injection molded plastics. Our fully-equipped injection molding department can produce parts as small as 0.005 pounds and as large as 9 pounds.
about:
Plastics, Inc. operates from Idaho Falls, Idaho, where it has produced injection-molded parts for nearly three decades. The company cites over 40 years of combined experience among its team, though a specific founding year and founder names are not disclosed.

The shop runs a fully equipped injection molding department capable of producing parts ranging from 0.005 to 9 pounds. In addition to molding, it offers plastic welding (sonic), plastic fabrication, CNC machining, post-machining, assembly, prototyping, thermoforming, and CAD design services. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

The company serves the electronics industry, supplying housings and enclosures, and also produces parts for ATV and snowmobile applications. Customer types are not detailed beyond general custom plastic fabrication.

Plastics, Inc. emphasizes that all work is performed in-house in Idaho Falls without outsourcing to China, highlighting U.S.-based production. It positions itself as a full-service provider able to handle projects of any size, from prototype through final assembly.
